descriptions.en: Shows the current NetEase Cloud Music track in the notch tray: album art, scrolling lyrics, progress, and previous / play-pause / next controls. Optional online lyrics. Requires NetEase Cloud Music and macOS Automation permission. Failed explicit controls now show a native notch alert, including control errors previously hidden by a normal playback refresh. Permission explanations appear only after a click; background refresh stays silent and pauses automatic retries while permission is required. Lyrics and playback notifications keep their existing behavior. Requires NotchAny 1.0.19 or later.
descriptions.zh-Hans: 在刘海托盘显示网易云当前曲目：封面、滚动歌词、进度条和上一曲/播放暂停/下一曲。可选在线歌词。需要已安装网易云音乐并授予自动化权限。 主动控制失败时显示原生刘海提示，不再用正常播放状态掩盖操作错误。点击权限入口后在刘海中说明授权路径；后台刷新保持静默，缺少权限时暂停自动重试。歌词与播放通知沿用现有机制。需要 NotchAny 1.0.19 或更高版本。

summaries.en: Now-playing widget for NetEase Cloud Music with lyrics and controls.
summaries.zh-Hans: 刘海屏网易云音乐播放器：封面、同步歌词与播放控制。
